scientific_question: After the independently validated v10.9 finite-grid full-linear KRR screen passed 0/5, can one small observation-only nonlinear detector model learn a dual proposal that survives the unchanged exact A^T, observable alpha, and CGLS K1 path on complete held-out trajectories?

model.input: three frozen detector views packed as six centered 14x30 component channels
model.architecture: width-32 input convolution, four residual blocks with dilation 1/2/4/1, global channel context, one output convolution, six learned skip gains
model.symmetry: G(a y)=a G(y) for finite nonzero-RMS observations through per-frame RMS normalization and odd symmetrization

training.shuffle: deterministic epoch and outer-fold NumPy permutation
training.loss: mean downstream teacher deficiency q after exact A^T, alpha, and K1 plus 0.1 times normalized K3-certificate relative-L2
training.teacher: zero-start CGLS K4 field and its projection
training.checkpoint_selection: none; use exactly epoch 120 in every fold

execution_protocol.geometry: construct the frozen inverse from the p=33kw_size=01 calibration coordinates only; do not stat, hash, open, or load rho.npy or times.npy
execution_protocol.input_binding: read observations.npy exactly once to immutable bytes, hash those bytes, and parse the same bytes; report the exact six-file pre-truth roster
execution_protocol.truth_barrier: all five epoch-120 checkpoints and their digests must be atomically frozen before any gauge_truth.npy bytes are read
execution_protocol.score_barrier: no per-fold score is written to progress or report until all five checkpoints exist and truth access is authorized by the global checkpoint barrier
execution_protocol.checkpoint_paths: exactly fold_0.npz through fold_4.npz as regular non-symlink single-link files inside the run directory
execution_protocol.source_binding: clean Git commit plus SHA-256 closure of runner, model, operator, compatibility, geometry, and contract; independent validation separately binds itself and its numerical helper closure
execution_protocol.deployment_ledger: instrument every complete per-frame A and A^T application during the candidate A^T-alpha-CGLS-K1 path and independently recount it in NumPy

shared_downstream.path: CNN dual proposal -> exact A^T -> observable alpha in [0,2] -> unchanged CGLS K1
shared_downstream.compatibility_gate: unchanged field, gradient, and observation envelope

decision.sentinel_pass: at least 4 of 5 held-out trajectories pass and every failed trajectory has zero severe-harm frames and at most 0.05 joint harm
decision.failure: otherwise stop architecture scaling and inspect loss, representation, and regime coverage
decision.fresh_authorization: a 5/5 fit-only pass is necessary but not sufficient; a separate frozen fresh release is still required
